text: Artificial intelligence, or AI, is the ability of computers and machines to perform tasks that normally require human intelligence. This includes understanding language, recognizing pictures, and making decisions. A key part of AI is machine learning, where computers learn from data instead of following fixed instructions. By analyzing large amounts of information, they improve their performance over time. A more advanced form of this is deep learning, which uses complex networks similar to the human brain to solve harder problems. You probably use AI every day. When your phone predicts your next word, when a map app finds the fastest route, or when a streaming service recommends a movie, AI is working quietly behind the scenes to make life more convenient.
